title: Phone number
description: This program asks for a 10-digit phone number and sends a verification code to it.
For some numbers it works. For most, the code goes to a completely different number.
Fix it so every 10-digit phone number comes back out exactly as it was typed in.
hints: What's the largest number an int can hold?
Most 10-digit numbers are bigger than 2,147,483,647. Use a bigger type, or don't store the phone number as a number at all.
